sandbox.description: an actual or requested container or jail on the computer recorded in its workspace; placement is never inferred from the graph host

provider.description: the configured sandbox implementation, not an LLM provider entity

address.description: the external sandbox resource locator, not a computer address

from.description: the initial Git commit; provenance does not reconstruct subsequent edits

image.description: the requested image when the backend supports images

released.description: confirmed disposal of a sandbox; written only after external disposal succeeds, never on a home switch

via.description: the session through which disposal was requested
